images.shows: Right-hand page headed 'Chiffre du Roy, escript au Sr de Maisse': a=7 b=8 c=9 d=10 e=11 f=1 g=2 h=3 i=4 l=5 m=6 n=12 o=13 p=14 q=15 r=16 s=17 t=18 u=19 x=20 y=21 z=22, with a 'Doubles' (homophone) section ff/mm/nn/../ss/uu = 66-73(ish). Left-hand page headed 'Allarme d'Italie, au mois de Mars 1591', a nomenclator of place/office code numbers, plus a 'Nulles' line.

Left page: illuminated title leaf, 'Registre des Instructions, Pouvoirs et Despesches Baillees a Monsieur de Maisse par le deffunt Roy Henry Troisiesme...', with a note that the register also contains all of Maisse's own letters to the late King and Henri IV and their responses. Right page: 'Instruction' text beginning the register proper, in plain French secretary hand.

note: Front-matter leaves f3-f5 carry at least three/four distinct cipher key tables (headed 'Chiffre du Roy escript au Sr de Maisse', 'Chiffre envoye a Mons.r de Maisse', a third 'Chiffre du Roy avec Sr de...', and 'Brefves, a de Maisse') before the register text proper begins at f6v/f8r. Only f3 was saved here; f4-f5 were viewed but not saved (same character as f3, additional tables).
